questions: Has the left eye become noticeably more prominent or swollen recently?
Did this change begin suddenly, over days, or gradually over weeks or months?
Is your vision in the left eye blurred or reduced compared with the right eye?
Do you have severe pain in or around the left eye?
Is the left eye markedly red or unusually sensitive to light?
Do you have pain when moving the left eye or difficulty moving it?
Have you had sudden severe headache, nausea, or vomiting with the eye symptoms?
Have you noticed flashes, new floaters, or a curtain-like shadow in your vision?
Have you had any recent injury or surgery involving the eye, face, or head?
Have you had fever or felt generally unwell?
Have you noticed swelling, redness, or tenderness around the eye?
Have you had a recent sinus infection or dental infection?
Do you have a history of thyroid disease or symptoms such as palpitations, heat intolerance, or unexplained weight loss?
Have you previously had a similar problem with either eye?
Do you have diabetes, a weakened immune system, or take steroid or immune-suppressing medication?
Have you noticed weakness, numbness, facial drooping, difficulty speaking, or trouble walking?
